description: This file defines a JavaScript function 'set_return_prospect_list_and_save' that manipulates form elements in a web-based CRM interface to establish relationships between a prospect list and a campaign, then submits the form to save the relationship.

methods.name: set_return_prospect_list_and_save(popup_reply_data)
methods.description: Sets form values based on provided popup reply data, configures form for saving a campaign-prospect list relationship, and submits the form.
